Senate Democrats must vote against this CR. This isn’t about government funding.

It’s about whether Dems are going to support cuts to veterans’ health care & nutrition assistance, while giving Trump & Musk more power to dismantle government.

Senate Dems must stand up to Trump.

@RulesDemocrats @HouseDemocrats 🚨UPDATE🚨

I was finally able to testify before the @RulesDemocrats to fight against the Republican budget that takes health care away from 13.7 million Americans, increases health care costs, and slashes nutrition benefits. https://t.co/j6xJzysudL

🚨UPDATE🚨

I was finally able to testify before the @RulesDemocrats to fight against the Republican budget that takes health care away from 13.7 million Americans, increases health care costs, and slashes nutrition benefits. https://t.co/cWXyWVs4o5

I voted NO on the Republican budget bill, which: 

➡️Takes away health care from 13.7 million people
➡️Increases our deficit by more than $4 trillion
➡️Slashes nutrition benefits
➡️Guts the Affordable Care Act

This isn't over.

We will continue our fight against this BS bill as it goes through the legislative process.

3 years ago today, Roe was overturned. Since then, women have been denied care, criminalized for miscarriages, and forced to flee their home states for basic treatment. This is not freedom — it’s government control. We can’t fix it in this Congress. But we can fight like hell.

#DobbsvsJackson #BansOffOurBodies #ChangeIsInHerHands #TX32

I went to the House Floor with a simple amendment: no cuts to Medicaid or SNAP.

Republicans shut it down.

They’re fine with gutting health care and food assistance, just as long as Trump and his friends get their tax cuts. https://t.co/vcrLj3H1Yw

Throughout the day, Democrats have attempted to offer amendments to save Medicaid, protect SNAP, and more.

Republicans have REJECTED each one of our amendments.

I was joined by my good friends @repkmr, @Rep_McBride, and @KellyMorrisonMN to explain what's going on. https://t.co/9xygMjffx6

Because even Republicans know their “Big Ugly Bill” is too toxic to see the light of day.

If you’re gutting health care and taking food off people’s tables, of course you do it at 3:28 AM. 

Shame doesn’t sleep.

Republicans are knowingly passing a budget that will take away health care from millions. 

In #TX32 alone, 102,000 people rely on Medicaid. Taking that away is reckless and cruel.

People will suffer. People will die. And they know it.

Over 102k people in #TX32 rely on Medicaid, including 80K children and 12K seniors, and another 103K count on ACA coverage to get the care they need. This budget takes that coverage away & hikes premiums by as much as $13K a year for some families.

Had a thoughtful and productive conversation with @AARPTX about the challenges facing older Texans, from the rising cost of prescription drugs to threats to Social Security, Medicare, and long-term care.

I’ll keep fighting to protect the dignity and health of our seniors. https://t.co/HGBHcfRJ5s

📣 We’re bringing our office to you in Balch Springs Sat, Aug 9th, from 11 AM - 1 PM to help with federal casework like:

✔️ Social Security
✔️ Medicare
✔️ Veterans benefits
✔️ Immigration

And more! Come get help—no appointment needed. 

#tx32 #officehours #congressonyourcorner https://t.co/TtAEkJQmBM

As we mark 60 years of Medicaid & Medicare, Trump’s budget guts these lifelines, taking health care away from families and seniors. 

I’ll keep fighting to protect them and make health care affordable for every Texan. #ProtectMedicare #ProtectMedicaid

@mealsonwheelscc is on the front lines of fighting nutrition gaps — especially for seniors who too often fall through the cracks. Grateful to see their work up close and recommit to ensuring no one in TX-32 goes hungry. #MealsOnWheels #TX32 #NorthTexasCares #JobsWithJulie https://t.co/dGA5y83Hud

I visited Highlands Skilled Nursing to meet with staff & residents about how Medicaid cuts are hurting care for our seniors. 

I’ll always fight for our nursing homes, as every resident deserves the dignity and quality care they’ve earned. https://t.co/0SQLjn2WR9
Today feels like a great day to exercise my constitutionally given right of congressional oversight at the Bluebonnet ICE Detention Center.  @HomelandDems https://t.co/LYH48BWh3a

This week, Republicans pushed through their defense policy bill with harmful anti-#LGBTQ provisions.

Instead of focusing on supporting servicemembers and families, they chose discrimination.

I voted NO because every servicemember deserves dignity, respect, and equal treatment.

Since 2003, PEPFAR, the U.S. President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief, has saved 26 million lives & provided treatment to more than 20 million people worldwide.

But today, Trump & Republicans are undermining one of America’s greatest bipartisan successes. @HouseForeign https://t.co/v52vkDB31t

Today, I introduced the Bipartisan Patient Access to Autoimmune Treatments Act to make it easier for patients with autoimmune diseases and blood disorders to access the medications they need. The bill limits prior authorization requirements under Medicare Advantage and Part D to once per year.

This commonsense reform has bipartisan support — just like the version I passed in the Texas State House with Democrats and Republicans, which Gov. Greg Abbott signed into law.

With the backing of the @AmerMedicalAssn, @texmed, and the @AutoimmuneAssoc, we’re building real momentum. Patients don’t have time for bureaucracy — and with this bill, they won’t have to.

If Republicans refuse to extend the Affordable Care Act's health care tax credits, an additional 15 million people will be kicked off their health insurance.

Their goal is to dismantle the ACA piece by piece, and Democrats won't stand for it. #RepublicanShutdown https://t.co/f9Xe2xflx7

Need help with Social Security, Medicare, passports, or other federal issues? We’re hitting the road with Mobile Office Hours so you don’t have to come to us—we’ll come to you! Happening TODAY! https://t.co/PrFJTvy20m

Republicans have attacked every corner of our health care system — from Medicaid and Medicare to Planned Parenthood and cancer research. 

Now they want to raise your health care costs by thousands of dollars. I’m fighting to make care more affordable, not less. https://t.co/JJmYELRrWJ
